title: Mike Acheson Fights Home Development Near Farmland

subtasks.task_text: Present Mike Acheson's background and role.
subtasks.text: Mike Acheson works at a family nursery in West Delray Beach and is president of the local chapter of the Florida Nursery Growers and Landscape Association.

subtasks.task_text: Advocate against the proposed housing development in West Boca Raton.
subtasks.text: Mike and his group aim to convince the Palm Beach County Commission to vote against the proposal for 1077 new homes.

subtasks.task_text: Express concerns about potential loss of farmland.
subtasks.text: Acheson believes that if GL Homes gets approval to build in West Boca, farmland in the area will diminish rapidly.
